summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AR360 e-commerce platform after PostgreSQL to MongoDB migration. Backend APIs 100% passing (28/28 tests). Frontend loads correctly with all pages accessible. Authentication uses Firebase (Google + Email/Password) - traditional username/password login is backend-only and not exposed in UI.

issues: Watch image displayed is not relevant to recovery products - appears to be placeholder image

passed_tests: GET /api/products - returns 9 products with correct structure (id, name, description, price, visibility, categoryId)
GET /api/products/:id - returns individual product by MongoDB ObjectId
GET /api/user - session persistence works after login
GET /api/admin/users - returns user list for admin (requires auth + admin role)
POST /api/discount-codes/validate - correctly returns 404 for invalid codes
Homepage loads with navigation, hero section, featured products
Shop page displays products with correct pricing ($39.95, $79.95, etc.)
Auth page has Login/Register tabs, Firebase integration (Google + Email)
Membership page shows $29 pricing and benefits
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id is correctly transformed to 'id' field using transformDoc/transformDocs helpers in types.ts
Frontend uses Firebase auth exclusively - traditional /api/login endpoint exists but is not used by UI
Admin users (admin, kevinmacpherson08) can login via backend /api/login but frontend requires Firebase email/password
Session persistence works correctly with express-session + connect-mongo
